text: At fixed revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, ComposeMessage initially takes the first parsed email from replyTo or author. For ReplyToList on the currently displayed message, a present List-Post header replaces email before the noreply regex. The warning therefore does not always test the parsed sender. The anchored local-part expression accepts plus in the suffix after reply; it is not an arbitrary address/domain substring match. confirmEx offers cancel or reply anyway, so this is a warning rather than a sending prohibition. This narrows the recipient-source wording of immutable lesson9e278db9a75a54c87b0763c7e346d870110edb5f0e0ccfbcb02ed334570ee8ae, while preserving its supported regex and prompt facts. The historical1565 landing only adds plus to the suffix character group. Exact source and complete assigned discussion inspected; no regex/UI/runtime test ran.
title: Choose the actual reply recipient before the noreply warning
